name: robots/tongji-cdi__temi
title: Temi robot (temi.api:Temi)
intro: Temi robot (temi.api:Temi), adapted from tongji-cdi/temi. It runs `goto`, `speak`, `ask`, `interface` and 1 more. `goto`: go to a saved location and report whether Temi says it reached it. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/robots/tongji-cdi__temi --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/robots/tongji-cdi__temi --backend fake --mcp
